GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2018-02-25T09:09:25Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Binance receiving error code -2015 while using API keys
Description: Hi,
 
I have created a new Binance account and set its API keys (read info, enable trading, IP access unrestricted).
While trying to connect to my account programmaticly using CCXT, I get the following authorization error: `ccxt.base.errors.ExchangeError: binance: unknown error code: {"code":-2015,"msg":"Invalid API-key, IP, or permissions for action."}`
OS: Ubuntu 16 (happens on windows as well)
Programming language: Python 3.5 
CCXT version: 1.10.1178

When using `python-binance` library, I successfully connect to my account.

The code I use:
```
from binance.client import Client
import json
import ccxt

data = json.load(open('binance_auth.json'))

client = Client(
    data['secret'],
    data['key'])

api = {
                'apiKey': data['key'],
                'secret': data['secret'],
                'password': None,
      }
ccxtBinance = ccxt.binance(api)

print("python-binance=", client.get_account()) # succeeds
print ("ccxt=",ccxtBinance.fetchBalance())     # fails
```

Thanks,
Lena
